verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Founders Workbench tools, such as Document Driver and the calculators, take user inputs, so asking about data retention and deletion controls is fair. Nothing in the evidence documents any user-facing retention settings, deletion requests, or data-lifecycle controls. The Data, Privacy & Cybersecurity page describes a legal advisory practice, not a product capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
